extracted.name: Prosciutto and Parmesan Pinwheels
ingredient_lines: 1 (17.5 ounce) package frozen puff pastry sheets, thawed
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a baking sheet with nonstick oil spray.
Roll thawed pastry out onto a flat surface. Spread Dijon mustard on pastry sheets. Cover pastry with a layer of prosciutto, then cheese.
Roll sheets, beginning on the long side. Cut into 1-inch thick sections.
Arrange sections on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 to 12 minutes.
